title: Spatium Computationis v3: Mini-Verse Engines, Riemannian Geometry, and Autonomous Intelligence Battleground Architecture
description: Production-grade autonomous intelligence system operating within a physically-grounded simulation substrate. All implementations use real SI units and validated conservation laws.
